SASBDB entry SASDRS2  (https://www.sasbdb.org/data/SASDRS2/)

Publication: A solution structure analysis reveals a bent collagen triple helix in the complement activation recognition molecule mannan-binding lectin.
DOI:         https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jbc.2022.102799

Files (downloaded from SASBDB, unmodified): experimental_data/SASDRS2.dat (q in 1/A),
SASDRS2_fit1_model1.pdb (PyMOL atomic model, 3 chains, with hydrogens, ACE/NH2 caps and
HYP residues), SASDRS2_fit1.fit (CRYSOL, chi^2 1.446).
